name: nidaniq-video-showcase
description: 40-second programmatic auth-to-app showcase video for NidanIQ (Remotion)

scripts.studio: npm run sound && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sound && remotion render src/index.ts NidanIQShowcase out/nidaniq_showcase.mp4
scripts.render:4k: npm run sound && remotion render src/index.ts NidanIQShowcase out/nidaniq_showcase_4k.mp4 --scale 2 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p
